_comment: Hand-maintained inputs to the generateCountryData Gradle task (see 'Country data' in CLAUDE.md).
articles: country article to use where the ISO table links to a page that is not the country.
flagPages: flag article to use where 'Flag of <country>' does not exist or is not the right page.
flagImageFiles: Commons file to use where a flag article has no lead image.
noOfficialFlag: country code -> why it has no official flag. These get flagImage null, and the reason is copied to flagNote in country_data.json.
Whether a country belongs in noOfficialFlag is a judgement from the Wikipedia flag articles, which word it differently; change it here.

flagPages.tw: Flag of the Republic of China

noOfficialFlag.aq: Antarctica has no official flag: no country owns it and no institution can adopt one, so every flag in use is unofficial.
noOfficialFlag.bl: Uses the French national flag; the arms-on-white flag used locally is unofficial.
noOfficialFlag.bq: The three islands together have no flag; Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba each have their own, and the Dutch national flag is used for the whole.
noOfficialFlag.gf: Uses the French national flag; the green and yellow flag used locally is unofficial.
noOfficialFlag.gp: Uses the French national flag; the locally used flags are unofficial.
noOfficialFlag.mf: Uses the French national flag; the logo flag used locally is unofficial.
noOfficialFlag.pm: Uses the French national flag; the Grande Hermine flag flown locally is unofficial.
noOfficialFlag.re: Uses the French national flag; Réunion has no separate official flag.
noOfficialFlag.sh: The territory has no flag of its own; Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha each have their own flag.
noOfficialFlag.wf: Uses the French national flag; the red saltire flag used locally is unofficial.
noOfficialFlag.yt: Uses the French national flag; Mayotte has no official flag of its own.
